story.titleZh: 欢迎巴德士科成为我们的官方银行合作伙伴
story.summaryZh: 在圣保罗大奖赛之前，我们宣布巴德士科成为我们的官方银行合作伙伴。巴德士科是巴西领先的金融机构，已经支持了Stock Car、TCR和巴西Formula 4，并且自Rafa Câmara在Formula 3时期起就支持他。

story.originalTitle: Welcoming @bradesco as our Official Banking Partner 🤝🇧🇷 We're delighted to partner with Bradesco, one of Brazil's leading financial instituti...
story.summaryEn:
Welcoming @bradesco as our Official Banking Partner 🤝🇧🇷
We're delighted to partner with Bradesco, one of Brazil's leading financial institutions, announced ahead of the São Paulo Grand Prix.
Bradesco already supports Stock Car, TCR and Formula 4 Brazil, and has backed our 2027 driver Rafa Câmara since his Formula 3 days. Now we're taking that journey further together 👊
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:
欢迎巴德士科成为我们的官方银行合作伙伴 🤝🇧🇷
我们很高兴与巴德士科合作，它是巴西领先的金融机构，这一宣布是在圣保罗大奖赛之前做出的。
巴德士科已经支持了Stock Car、TCR和巴西Formula 4，并且自Rafa Câmara在Formula 3时期起就支持他。现在，我们将共同继续这段旅程 👊
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP

"I think the baseline is good, and it’s now at the fine-tuning stage of understanding what we can do better on the medium and hard compounds, and at the same time, getting a bit more out of the soft tire." 🗣️ AK
Wrapping up Friday in São Paulo 🇧🇷
#HaasF1 #F1 #BrazilGP
detailZh:

在圣保罗结束周五的比赛 🇧🇷
